strings.模型列表为空，可手动输入模型 ID: No models returned. Enter a model ID manually.
strings.Claude 使用 CLI 默认模型或官方别名，实际可用性由账号/服务配置决定；: Claude uses CLI defaults or official model aliases. Availability depends on your account; effort overrides are not supported.
strings.Codex / Claude 分别保存配置与会话。切换引擎不会自动发送请求。: Codex and Claude have separate settings and sessions. Switching engines does not send requests.
strings.下次启动生效；关闭此项不会删除本地历史: Applies on next launch; disabling does not delete history.
strings.专注模式：收起所有辅助区域，再次点击恢复原布局。: Focus hides auxiliary panels. Click again to restore the layout.
strings.从一段 SQL、一个错误，或一个分析目标开始。: Start with SQL, an error, or an analysis goal.
strings.太阳 / 月亮：切换 Light / Dark 主题。: Sun / moon switches between Light and Dark.
strings.尚未连接数据库 · 查询结果将在这里展示: No database connection. Query results will appear here.
strings.工作区 / 入门工作台 · 本次编辑仅保留在内存中: Workspace / Welcome — edits are kept in memory.
strings.当前仅开放只读分析，不执行数据库写入: Read-only analysis; database writes are not executed.
strings.当前仅提供文本/只读分析；使用所选 CLI 的已有登录状态。: Text and read-only analysis using your existing CLI login.
strings.当前编辑仅保留在内存中，关闭窗口后丢失。: Edits are kept in memory and lost when the window closes.
strings.打开 AI 面板时自动连接: Connect automatically when opening AI panel
strings.配置 AI 服务，解释 SQL、分析问题并整理查询思路。: Configure AI to explain SQL, analyze problems and plan queries.
strings.顶部布局图标：显示或隐藏左侧栏、运行输出与右侧辅助面板。: Use the toolbar to toggle sidebar, output and auxiliary panels.
strings.项目 / 连接：点击切换侧栏，再次点击当前项收起。: Projects / Connections switches sidebar. Click the active item to collapse it.
strings.连接配置集中管理；表、视图与 DDL 位于右侧表结构面板。: Manage connections here. Tables, views and DDL appear in the schema panel.
strings.仅管理 .note 文件。当前为示例文档，文件管理将在后续接入。: Manage .note files here. This is a sample; file management is not yet connected.
strings.包含 SQL、Markdown 与任务。当前为内存示例，尚未保存到磁盘。: Contains SQL, Markdown and tasks. This sample is in memory and not saved to disk.
strings.这里将展示表、视图、函数、字段、索引及 DDL。: Tables, views, functions, columns, indexes and DDL will appear here.
strings.未连接数据库 · 内存示例 · SQL Notebook: No database connection    ·    In-memory sample    ·    SQL Notebook
strings.配置在本地保存，API Key 不会用于 CLI 登录。: Settings are stored locally. API keys are separate from CLI authentication.
strings.安装后配置可执行文件；扩展智能体暂不接入内置聊天。: Configure the executable after installation. Extension agents are not connected to built-in chat yet.
strings.自动保存未完成，请检查配置: Auto-save is incomplete. Check your settings.
strings.配置 AI 引擎后连接；使用已有 CLI 登录状态: Configure an AI engine, then connect using your existing CLI login.
strings.已断开，重新连接会创建新会话: Disconnected. Reconnecting starts a new session.
strings.请先停止当前回答，再修改 AI 设置: Stop the current response before changing AI settings.
strings.请选择实际引擎 .exe，不支持 .cmd / .ps1: Select the engine .exe; .cmd and .ps1 are not supported.
strings.Agent working directory does not exist: Agent working directory does not exist
strings.Advanced parameters must be a JSON objec: Advanced parameters must be a JSON object
strings.Advanced parameters cannot override mode: Advanced parameters cannot override model, messages or input
strings.Model request failed or timed out: Model request failed or timed out
strings.Update check failed or timed out: Update check failed or timed out
strings.Use HTTPS (HTTP is allowed for localhost: Use HTTPS (HTTP is allowed for localhost); omit credentials, query and fragment
strings.SQL 笔记与 AI 数据工作台: SQL notebooks and AI data workspace
strings.数据库连接功能尚未接入: Database connections are not available yet
strings.切换前会自动保存；生成或连接期间不可切换: Changes auto-save before switching. Switching is unavailable while connecting or generating.
strings.请先停止当前生成，再切换引擎: Stop the current response before switching agents
